text:
alex: FYI postmortem is up: https://redwood/pms/INC-4822. Main follow-up: rollout timing correlates with peak KV cache churn. We need concrete action items for flag audits, rollout windows, and a short auto-rollback patch.

sam: reading it now. quick Q — do we already have a per-feature rollout window metric? iirc only per-model.

jing: not for feature flags today. we have an events stream that can be joined to produce windows. i can sketch an audit query this week. :calendar:

paul: i'll own the auto-rollback PR. plan is simple: detect sustained error rate >3% for 5m in the rollout cohort => flip to previous variant + alert. estimate 2 days to prototype.

lisa: +1 on ownership. can you also add an opt-out toggle for Dedicated tenants? some customers want manual control.

paul: yep, make it config per-tenant and default on for self-serve.

oncall-sre: recurring pattern note: two incidents in last 3 months show rollout overlaps with heavy cache-priming jobs at 02:00 UTC. we should avoid our default ramp windows overlapping the batch jobs schedule.

alex: good catch. action: schedule gating policy update to disallow rollouts in 01:30-03:00 UTC unless explicitly approved. owner: sam. due EOD Tue.

sam: taking owner for gating policy. will add a policy flag and a CI check for deployment pipelines. target Tue EOD.

jing: here's a quick audit query I put in the thread for review:
```sql
SELECT flag_name, COUNT(*) as events, SUM(case when variant='new' AND error=true then 1 else 0 end) as errs
FROM flag_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY flag_name
ORDER BY errs DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
useful to spot high-error flags during ramps.

paul: nice. for the rollback rule I'll use these signals + latency p95 delta > 200ms. also will add a short circuit: if kv-cache-miss-rate > 10% in cohort then immediately pause ramp.

lisa: timeline ask: can we get a rollout checklist and a tiny runbook update before the next deploy window? helps support teams.

alex: agreed. jing — runbook + audit query in 3 days? paul — rollback PR in 2 days. sam — gating policy + CI check Tue EOD. i'll consolidate into the incident follow-ups doc and ping execs.

paul: will open a draft PR and link it here when ready. cc @devops-bot for deploy guardrail tests.

devops-bot: new ticket created: INF-1127 "auto-rollback prototype" assigned to paul. CI job scheduled: rollout-gate-check.

oncall-sre: after the prototype, let's run a 1-week shadow test on staging traffic that mimics peak priming runs. we need to validate false positive rate.

alex: agreed on shadow test. add that as a follow-up: owner oncall-sre, due in 2 weeks.

sam: I'll add the UTC blackout window enforcement to the pipeline templates and add a notification to the release checklist.

jing: I'll also add a small script to enumerate flags missing ramp-schedule metadata and output CSV for owners. quick snippet: `./tools/flag-audit --missing-schedule > missing.csv`

lisa: thanks. can we also include an ownership column so support knows who to ping?

jing: yep will join with team_metadata.

alex: final: I'm creating a short tracker in the postmortem with these rows — (policy update: sam, Tue), (rollback PR: paul, +2d), (audit query & runbook: jing, +3d), (shadow test: oncall-sre, +14d), (flag ownership CSV: jing, +5d). I'll check in on Friday. :white_check_mark:

paul: ack.

sam: ack.

jing: ack.

lisa: ack, and i'll prep a support note template for customers affected by rollbacks.

oncall-sre: adding a recurring monthly check to our incident hygiene board to look for rollout-timing clusters.

alex: nice. thanks all — will update the postmortem follow-up list and assign in the tracker. if anything slips, ping here.
